name: ai-gateway
description: Self-hosted multi-provider AI API gateway on Cloudflare Workers

PROXY_TOKEN.description: Generate a random value with `npm run provider:secret -- generate-key`. Clients use this as the gateway Bearer token.

CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generate a separate 32-byte base64 key with `npm run provider:secret -- generate-key`. Store it securely; losing it prevents decrypting provider API keys in D1.
